{{short description|Canadian insurance group}} {{Infobox company | name = Aviva Canada Inc. | logo = Aviva Logo.svg | hq_location = [[Markham, Ontario]] | key_people = Nav Dhillon, CEO{{cite web |title= Aviva appoints Navinder Dhillon as CEO of Aviva Canada. |url=https://www.aviva.ca/en/press-releases/2025/chief-executive-officer-announcement/ |website=aviva.com |access-date=17 December 2025|date=31 July 2025 }} | former_name = CGU Group Canada | industry = [[Insurance]] | services = Home, Auto, Specialty and Business Insurance | net_income = | assets = | equity = | owner = | num_employees = approx. 4,000 (2016) | predecessor = Commercial Union
General Accident | founded = {{Start date|1999|3|31|df=y}} | parent = [[Aviva|Aviva plc]] | divisions = | subsidiaries = | website = {{URL|https://www.aviva.ca}} }} [[File:AvivaCanadaMarkhamHeadquarters4.jpg|thumb|Aviva Canada's headquarters in Markham]] '''Aviva Canada Inc.''' is a Canadian property and casualty insurance company and a wholly owned subsidiary of the UK-based [[Aviva plc]].{{cite web|url=http://www.lib.uwo.ca/programs/companyinformationcanada/canadianpcinsuranceindustryleaders.html |title=Canadian P&C Insurance Industry Leaders | Western Libraries |access-date=2009-05-21 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101004210709/http://www.lib.uwo.ca/programs/companyinformationcanada/canadianpcinsuranceindustryleaders.html |archive-date=2010-10-04 }} It provides home, personal, automobile, recreational vehicle, group and business insurance to more than three million customers.{{Cite web |url=http://www.insurancego.ca/insurance-reviews/aviva-insurane-reviews.php |title=Aviva Insurane [sic] Reviews | Car, Home, Health, Life - Insurance Reviews & Companies |access-date=2012-08-31 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120813053420/http://www.insurancego.ca/insurance-reviews/aviva-insurane-reviews.php |archive-date=2012-08-13 |url-status=dead }} == History == Aviva Canada came into being on 31 March 1999 as the CGU Group Canada, and was created through the merger of the Commercial Union Assurance Company of Canada and the General Accident Assurance Company of Canada. The merger was the result of the 1998 merger of the mother companies, [[Commercial Union]] and [[General Accident]], to form [[CGU plc]]. After CGU merged with [[Norwich Union]] in 2000 to form [[Aviva]], the Canadian subsidiary changed its name to Aviva Canada. The operating subsidiaries of Aviva Canada Inc. are the Aviva Insurance Company of Canada, Aviva General Insurance Company, Elite Insurance Company, Pilot Insurance Company, Scottish & York Insurance Company, and Traders General Insurance Company. Effective June 1, 2006 Aviva policyholders in Quebec who drive hybrid vehicles received a 10% discount.{{cite news|title=Aviva offers premium discount in Quebec for hybrid cars|url=https://www.canadianunderwriter.ca/insurance/aviva-offers-premium-discount-in-quebec-for-hybrid-cars-1000052446/|access-date=23 May 2020|publisher=canadianunderwriter.ca|date=17 May 2006}} In March 2007, Aviva Canada began to offer "hole-in-one insurance" to organizations that sponsor golf tournaments across Canada. The Hole-in-One insurance product allows tournament organizers to offer a cash (or equivalent) prize to anyone who makes a hole-in-one on one of the par 3 holes. The product is coupled with an online quoting tool that can provide a quote in less than 15 seconds for insurance limits from C$5,000 to C$50,000.{{cite news|title=Aviva hits a hole-in-one with new insurance program|url=http://www.insurance-canada.ca/poladmin/announce/2007/Aviva-hole-one-insurance-704.php|access-date=23 May 2020|publisher=insurance-canada.ca|date=20 May 2007}} In 2008, the company announced that these companies will now operate as Aviva Pilot and Aviva Scottish & York.{{Cite web |url=http://www.investmentexecutive.com/client/en/News/DetailNews.asp?Id=44058&cat=149&IdSection=149&PageMem=&nbNews=&IdPub= |title=Aviva Canada rebrands Pilot and Scottish & York - Company news - News Investment Executive |access-date=2009-05-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110713052349/http://www.investmentexecutive.com/client/en/News/DetailNews.asp?Id=44058&cat=149&IdSection=149&PageMem=&nbNews=&IdPub= |archive-date=2011-07-13 |url-status=dead }} Other companies in the Aviva Canada group of companies include: Elite Insurance Company (also known as Aviva Elite), Traders General Insurance Company (also known as Aviva Traders) and S&Y Insurance Company.{{cite web|url=https://www.avivacanada.com/product.php?content%3DMEMBER_COMPANIES%26language%3DENGLISH |title=Aviva Canada |access-date=2009-05-21 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20061023083451/https://www.avivacanada.com/product.php?content=MEMBER_COMPANIES&language=ENGLISH |archive-date=2006-10-23 }} The company also has financial ownership of insurance intermediaries including Ontario Insurance Service Limited (OIS), Insurance Agent Service Inc. and Wayfarer Insurance Brokers Limited.{{cite web|url=https://www.avivacanada.com/product.php?content%3DFINANCIAL_OWNERSHIP%26language%3DENGLISH |title=Aviva Canada |access-date=2009-05-21 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20061023083838/https://www.avivacanada.com/product.php?content=FINANCIAL_OWNERSHIP&language=ENGLISH |archive-date=2006-10-23 }} In April 2009, Aviva Canada announced its agreement to acquire the business of National Home Warranty Group of Companies.{{cite news |title=Aviva Canada announces its agreement to acquire the business of National Home Warranty Group of Companies |url=http://www.insurance-canada.ca/business/canada/2008/Aviva-acquires-National-Home-Warranty-804.php |access-date=13 March 2021 |work=Insurance-Canada.ca |date=9 April 2008 |language=en-CA}} On 26 February 2014, the company announced that it would be relocating its headquarters to a new 12-storey office building located in [[Downtown Markham]].{{Cite web |url=http://www.newswire.ca/en/story/1313467/aviva-canada-selects-downtown-markham-for-new-head-office |title = AVIVA Canada | Aviva Canada Selects Downtown Markham for New Head Off… |archive-url=https://archive.today/20140227015844/http://www.newswire.ca/en/story/1313467/aviva-canada-selects-downtown-markham-for-new-head-office |archive-date=27 February 2014 |url-status=dead}} The building was slated to be completed in June 2017. In June 2013, Aviva Canada was faced with one of the costliest natural disasters in Canadian history, "days of torrential rain inundated the city of Calgary, Alberta, and surrounding areas. The Bow and Elbow Rivers overflowed their banks, causing the evacuation of 26 neighborhoods and 100,000 people. Four died, and a state of emergency was declared in 32 communities."[http://www.sas.com/de_de/customers/aviva-canada.html ''Get the full picture when disaster strikes''], SAS Institute. Retrieved, 5 November 2015 Insurable damages amounted to more than $1.7 billion. On January 21, 2016, the company announced the acquisition of RBC General Insurance Company, for CAD$582 million.{{cite news|title=AVIVA Canada completes the acquisition of RBC General Insurance|url=http://www.xprimm.com/AVIVA-Canada-completes-the-acquisition-of-RBC-General-Insurance-articol-1,8-8188.htm|access-date=23 May 2020|publisher=xprimm.com|date=13 July 2016}} In 2023, Aviva announced the appointment of Tracy Garrad as CEO of Aviva Canada.{{cite news|title=AVIVA Canada completes the acquisition of RBC General Insurance|url=https://www.insurancebusinessmag.com/uk/news/breaking-news/aviva-names-new-ceos-for-ukandi-gi-and-canada-457926.aspx|access-date=9 February 2023|publisher=insurancebusinessmag.com|date=30 August 2023}} Garrad stepped down in June 2025 to return to the UK to be with family and named Nav Dhillon as interim CEO.{{Cite web |title=Aviva Canada names interim CEO |url=https://www.insurancebusinessmag.com/ca/news/breaking-news/aviva-canada-names-interim-ceo-538751.aspx |access-date=2025-12-17 |website=www.insurancebusinessmag.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Aviva Canada chief executive officer returns to the United Kingdom |url=https://insurance-portal.ca/article/aviva-canada-chief-executive-officer-returns-to-the-united-kingdom/ |access-date=2025-12-17 |website=Insurance Portal |language=en}} On July 31, 2025, Aviva announced the appointment of Nav Dhillon as Chief Executive Officer of Aviva Canada. In this capacity, he reports to the Aviva Group CEO and is a member of Aviva’s Group Executive Committee.{{Cite web |title=Aviva Canada's new CEO to focus on commercial lines expansion, market leadership |url=https://www.insurancebusinessmag.com/ca/news/commercial-liability/aviva-canadas-new-ceo-to-focus-on-commercial-lines-expansion-market-leadership-546877.aspx |access-date=2025-12-17 |website=www.insurancebusinessmag.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Aviva-Canadas-executive-search-ends-with-a-familiar-face |url=https://www.insuranceinstitute.ca/en/Insights-And-Publications/CanadianUnderwriterArticles/items/2025/07/31/Aviva-Canadas-executive-search-ends-with-a-familiar-face |access-date=2025-12-17 |website=www.insuranceinstitute.ca}} ==Partnerships== From 2015-2025, Aviva Canada was a partner of [[Tennis Canada]] and sponsor of the ''Rogers Cup'' tournament.{{cite news|title=Aviva Canada announces partnerships with tennis star Genie Bouchard, Tennis Canada and Rogers Cup|url=https://www.rvwest.com/article/rvwestinsider/aviva_canada_announces_partnerships_with_tennis_star_genie_bouchard_tennis|access-date=23 May 2020|publisher=rvwest.com}}{{cite web |title=Tennis Canada signs ten-year Aviva agreement |url=https://www.sportspro.com/news/sponsorship-marketing/tennis_canada_signs_ten_year_aviva_agreement/ |website=SporstPro |access-date=4 July 2026 |date=12 June 2015}} In 2017, Aviva Canada formed a partnership with [[Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment]] (MLSE) to launch ''Toronto Raptors Insurance'' and ''Toronto Maple Leafs Insurance'' which covers home and auto insurance.{{cite news|title=Aviva marketing team-branded home, auto insurance to fans of Raptors, Maple Leafs|url=https://www.canadianunderwriter.ca/insurance/aviva-marketing-team-branded-home-auto-insurance-fans-raptors-maple-leafs-1004107658/|access-date=23 May 2020|publisher=canadianunderwriter.ca|date=19 January 2017}} ==Products and services== Aviva Canada offers Standard Insurance products such as [[Vehicle Insurance]] and [[Property insurance]].{{cite news|title=Factbox: Insurers Return Part of Auto Premiums as Coronavirus Cuts Driving|url=https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2020/05/19/us/19reuters-health-coronavirus-insurance-auto-factbox.html|access-date=23 May 2020|work=[[The New York Times]]|date=19 May 2020}} Aviva insurance offer auto, home, travel, and recreational insurance, as well as commercial property, liability, and fleet insurance. The company also offers Non-Standard Insurance products such as [[Pet insurance|Equine/Horse Insurance]], [[Prize indemnity insurance|Hole-in-One]], and [[Prize indemnity insurance|Prize Indemnity]].{{cite news|title=Covid-19 all round impact for non-life insurers: Experts|url=https://auto.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/auto-finance/covid-19-all-round-impact-for-non-life-insurers-experts/75491557|access-date=23 May 2020|publisher=economictimes.indiatimes.com|date=1 May 2020}} == References == {{Commons category}} {{Aviva}} [[Category:Aviva|Canada]] [[Category:Financial services companies established in 1999]] [[Category:Canadian subsidiaries of foreign companies]] [[Category:Insurance companies of Canada]] [[Category:Canadian companies established in 1999]] [[Category:1999 establishments in Ontario]] [[Category:Companies based in Markham, Ontario]]
extract: Aviva Canada Inc. is a Canadian property and casualty insurance company and a wholly owned subsidiary of the UK-based Aviva plc. It provides home, personal, automobile, recreational vehicle, group and business insurance to more than three million customers.
